title: ansi-regex under strip-ansi: the range already allows the fix
description: A project that depends on strip-ansi 5.2.0, whose lockfile was written in August 2021 and so holds ansi-regex 4.1.0, which the published advisory CVE-2021-3807 covers. strip-ansi accepts ^4.1.0, so the fix (4.1.1) needs no change to package.json: only the lockfile or an override has to move.
